detailed_description: Metric Imperial Converter is a comprehensive unit conversion tool that supports length, weight, volume, temperature, area, and speed conversions. Easily convert between metric units (meters, kilograms, liters) and imperial units (feet, pounds, gallons) with instant results.
usage_steps: Select a conversion category (length, weight, volume, etc.)
Enter the value you want to convert
Choose the source unit from the dropdown
Select the target unit for conversion
usage_examples: Convert kilometers to miles for travel planning
Convert kilograms to pounds for weight tracking
Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit for weather comparison
